Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and mesh_heading containing 'lymphoma'. Join drug_indication on molregno, then molecule_dictionary for chembl_id and pref_name, and compound_structures for canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN. Return indication_curie as efo_id, indication_label as mesh_heading, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
